categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong TianYiMa Information Industry Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the software and information technology services sector, focusing on smart city solutions. Its main business segments include smart government, smart education, smart healthcare, smart transportation, smart enterprises, and emerging areas such as computing power services, smart rail transit, and digital energy. The company offers integrated services including project planning, solution design, software development, project implementation, and system operation and maintenance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as IoT, big data, cloud computing, GIS, artificial intelligence, and digital twin technology. It has developed core capabilities in digital twin construction and application, government large model technology, big data analysis, image super-resolution and recognition, cross-platform high-performance audio-video communication, unified data integration, intelligent human-computer interaction, intelligent reporting, visualization workflows, and low-code application development. R&D is primarily conducted in-house with specialized teams and centers in Shenzhen, Shantou, and subsidiaries.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are government agencies, educational institutions, healthcare organizations, enterprises, and transportation sectors. The company serves over 1,000 cases across more than 20 provinces in China, focusing on public sector digital transformation and enterprise digitalization. Key markets include smart city infrastructure, digital government services, smart education platforms, healthcare IT, rail transit intelligent operations, and emerging digital energy projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates in China with a strong presence in South China, including Guangdong province, and expanding activities in Central, East, North, Southwest China, and Hong Kong. Its subsidiaries and branches are located in Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Chongqing, Hainan, and Hong Kong, supporting localized service delivery and regional market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong TianYiMa operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IT and smart city supply chain. It provides integrated software development, system integration, and IT services, along with hardware sales related to its solutions. The company also invests in upstream infrastructure such as computing power clusters and digital energy projects, indicating a partial upstream involvement.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on transformation and quality improvement, leveraging the digital economy growth opportunities. It emphasizes internal growth combined with external mergers and acquisitions, particularly in data asset management and computing power services. R&D priorities include enhancing smart government, education, healthcare, transportation solutions, and expanding into smart rail transit, digital energy, and data-driven services. The company has increased R&D investment and developed multiple innovative platforms and systems to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of integrated IT solutions, software development and technical services, system operation and maintenance services, and hardware sales. The company uses a project-based billing model tied to contract milestones such as initial acceptance, final acceptance, and warranty periods. It also earns income from power generation projects and data product commercialization. The sales model is predominantly direct sales with some participation as a supplier in larger system integrator projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company operates in a highly competitive software and IT services industry with many players and low market concentration. It positions itself as a leading smart city solution provider with strong expertise in government, education, healthcare, and transportation sectors. Its comprehensive technology portfolio, extensive project experience, and broad geographic footprint give it a competitive edge in grassroots social governance and digital transformation markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 224 million, a 45% decline from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 49.5 million. Total assets increased by 27.7% to RMB 1.33 billion. The company has a sizable order backlog of around RMB 800 million for 2025, indicating potential revenue recovery. R&D expenses accounted for 7.74% of revenue, reflecting sustained investment despite financial challenges. The company’s financial profile shows a transitional phase with strategic investments and restructuring.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guangdong TianYiMa emphasizes its integrated smart city solutions combining cutting-edge technologies like AI, IoT, big data, and cloud computing to deliver comprehensive digital transformation services. Its unique value lies in deep industry expertise, a broad portfolio of proprietary technologies and solutions, and strong project execution capabilities across multiple sectors. The company’s ability to provide end-to-end services from planning to operation, coupled with localized support and continuous innovation, differentiates it in the competitive IT services market.
